# Notebook 00 -- Variance decomposition (H4 / Objective 4)

**What this notebook does.** Partitions the variance of low-flow metrics
into **GCM choice × hydrological model structure (GR4J/GR6J) × EQM tail
policy**, blocked by catchment (and stratified by aridity tercile), with
catchment-bootstrap CIs. This is the H4 machinery; it is deliberately
**input-agnostic**: it reads one long-format table,

```
data_processed/decomp/input_metrics.csv
   catchment, arid_tercile, ssp, window, metric,
   gcm, structure ("GR4J"|"GR6J"), tail_policy ("constant"|"linear"),
   value, metric_note, n_gap_filled, extrapolation_share, pr_max_mm,
   metric_version
```

assembled by the SSP pipeline (QED_50 apply x2 tail policies -> GR4J and GR6J
simulation -> projection indicators). A smoke test with simulated data
validates the machinery before any real input exists.

**Design (pre-registered 18 Nov 2026):**

1. **Per catchment, per metric, per (ssp, window):** a three-way ANOVA
   `value ~ gcm * structure * tail_policy` on the full factorial grid
   (14 GCMs x 2 structures x 2 tail policies = 56 runs per catchment);
   variance shares = SSterm / SStotal for gcm, structure, tail_policy and
   their two-way interactions (residual = the rest). Type-I sequential
   sums are avoided: the grid is complete and balanced, so SS are
   orthogonal and ordering does not matter.
2. **Aggregation:** variance shares are summarized by aridity tercile as
   medians across catchments; catchment-bootstrap (1,000 resamples,
   recorded seed) gives 95% CIs on each share.
3. **H4 decision rule (AGENTS.md, fixed):** GCM is expected to dominate;
   the structure share is "non-negligible" if its median share is >= 5%
   in at least one aridity tercile for at least one headline metric.
   H4 FAILS if structure < 5% everywhere — still a useful negative result.
4. **No blending:** every metric is decomposed separately (responses are
   never averaged into a composite before decomposition).
5. **GCM set is stated, never balanced away (guardrail 7).** `HadGEM3-GC31-MM`
   has no published ssp245/ssp370 on ESGF, so those two SSPs run a 13-GCM
   factorial (52 runs per catchment) and ssp126/ssp585 a 14-GCM one (56 runs).
   Each cell is balanced; the verdict records the coverage per SSP.
6. **The per-cell design is SATURATED (spec v2, 23 Nov 2026, § 5.0).** Rows per
   cell = |GCM| x 2 x 2 = 56 (52) and the model `value ~ gcm * structure *
   tail_policy` has exactly 56 (52) parameters, so residual df = 0: the
   per-cell ANOVA is an **exact variance partition, not a significance test**.
   No F, no p, no per-cell CI from the ANOVA; eta-partial is identically 1 and
   omega-squared undefined under saturation, so neither is computed. The SS
   share over the seven terms **is** classical eta-squared in this balanced
   design. Inference = the pre-registered 5% disjunction rule + the
   catchment bootstrap (which is *why* the bootstrap exists). This is verified
   against the real input in the production chunk before any fit.

```{r log-file}
decomp_output_dir <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "decomp")
dir.create(decomp_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
decomp_log_file <- file.path(decomp_output_dir, "decomp_00_log.txt")
```

## 1. Configuration

```{r config}
decomp_n_boot  <- 1000L
decomp_seed    <- 20261118L
decomp_h4_structure_min <- 0.05   # structure share matters if >= 5%
decomp_min_runs <- 52L            # balanced factorial floor: 13 GCM x 2 x 2
                                  # (14 GCM x 2 x 2 = 56 for ssp126/ssp585)
decomp_lmer_sensitivity <- TRUE   # spec v2 section 5.6: RECOMMENDED SENSITIVITY,
                                  # never the primary result. GCM as random
                                  # intercept is the only H4 model with an
                                  # error term, so it is the only place where
                                  # residual diagnostics / classical effect
                                  # sizes mean anything. BH-correction would
                                  # apply only if it emitted p-values; it does
                                  # not (variance-component share only).
```

## 2. Machinery (works on any input table with the factor columns)

```{r machinery}
decomp_one <- function(dt) {
   # dt: one catchment x metric x ssp x window slice, full factorial grid.
   # Spec v2 (23 Nov 2026): the design is saturated (n_obs = n_params), so the
   # fit is an exact variance partition over SEVEN terms -- main effects, the
   # three 2-way interactions AND the 3-way interaction (never buried in a
   # residual; there is none). Type I anova() is used: balanced + orthogonal
   # + saturated => I = II = III, and car::Anova would return NaN F/p with
   # 0 residual df. No F, no p, no eta-partial / omega-squared (degenerate).
   if (data.table::uniqueN(dt$gcm) < 3 ||
       data.table::uniqueN(dt$structure) < 2 ||
       data.table::uniqueN(dt$tail_policy) < 2) return(NULL)
   fit <- stats::aov(value ~ gcm * structure * tail_policy, data = dt)
   ss  <- summary(fit)[[1]][, "Sum Sq"]
   # rownames are space-padded by the anova print method in some R builds;
   # trim, then match with anchored patterns (substring matching would
   # otherwise pollute interactions: "gcm" also matches "gcm:structure")
   names(ss) <- trimws(rownames(summary(fit)[[1]]))
   ss <- ss[names(ss) != "Residuals"]   # 0 df, SS ~ 0: reported as exactly
                                        # zero, never fitted around (spec 5.1)
   total <- sum(ss, na.rm = TRUE)
   if (!is.finite(total) || total <= 0) return(NULL)
   get_share <- function(pattern) {
      k <- grepl(pattern, names(ss))
      if (!any(k)) return(0)
      sum(ss[k], na.rm = TRUE) / total
   }
   data.table::data.table(
      share_gcm        = get_share("^gcm$"),
      share_structure  = get_share("^structure$"),
      share_tail       = get_share("^tail_policy$"),
      share_gcm_struct = get_share("^gcm:structure$"),
      share_gcm_tail   = get_share("^gcm:tail_policy$"),
      share_struct_tail= get_share("^structure:tail_policy$"),
      share_three_way  = get_share("^gcm:structure:tail_policy$"),
      n_terms = length(ss))
}

decomp_run <- function(input, metrics, n_boot, seed) {
   stopifnot(all(c("catchment", "arid_tercile", "metric", "gcm",
                   "structure", "tail_policy", "value",
                   "ssp", "window") %in% names(input)))
   set.seed(seed)
   # One ANOVA per catchment x metric x SSP x window. Pooling scenarios or
   # windows into a single fit inflates the residual and makes shares
   # incomparable across horizons (fixed 21 Nov 2026: the grouping previously
   # stopped at catchment x metric, so 4 SSPs x 3 windows were treated as
   # replicates of the same cell).
   shares <- input[!is.na(value), decomp_one(.SD),
                   by = .(catchment, arid_tercile, metric, ssp, window)]
   shares <- shares[!is.null(share_gcm)]   # drop NULL slices from failed fits

   # tercile-median shares with catchment-bootstrap CIs
   cats <- unique(shares$catchment)
   boot_one <- function(b) {
      pick <- sample(cats, size = length(cats), replace = TRUE)
      shares[catchment %in% pick,
              .(share_gcm = stats::median(share_gcm),
                share_structure = stats::median(share_structure),
                share_tail = stats::median(share_tail)),
              by = .(arid_tercile, metric, ssp, window)][, b := b]
   }
   # (bootstrap done in the caller section so the deterministic first pass
   #  is separable and auditable)
   list(shares = shares)
}
```

## 3. Smoke test: synthetic full-factorial grid (machinery validation)

```{r smoke, eval=TRUE}
set.seed(42)
gcm      <- paste0("G", 1:14)
structure <- c("GR4J", "GR6J")
tailp    <- c("constant", "linear")
sim <- data.table::CJ(gcm = gcm, structure = structure, tail_policy = tailp)
sim[, value := 10 * (as.integer(factor(gcm)) - 7) / 7 +      # strong GCM effect
              3.0 * (structure == "GR6J") +                  # modest structure
              0.8 * (tail_policy == "linear") +              # small tail
              stats::rnorm(.N, 0, 0.5)]
sim[, `:=`(catchment = "T000", arid_tercile = "dry", metric = "q95_bias",
           n_gap_filled = 0L, extrapolation_share = 0,
           metric_version = "v1", ssp = "smoke", window = "smoke")]
res <- decomp_run(sim, metrics = "q95_bias", n_boot = 10, seed = 1)$shares
print(res)
stopifnot(res$share_gcm > 0.5, res$share_structure > 0.05,
          res$share_structure > res$share_tail)
share_sum <- res[, sum(share_gcm + share_structure + share_tail +
                       share_gcm_struct + share_gcm_tail + share_struct_tail +
                       share_three_way)]
stopifnot(abs(share_sum - 1) < 1e-6, res$n_terms[1] == 7L)
cat("smoke test passed: GCM-dominant grid recovers the planted order",
    "(gcm > structure > tail); seven-term partition sums to 1\n")
```

## 4. Production hook (runs when the SSP metric table exists)

```{r production, eval=file.exists(file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "decomp", "input_metrics.csv"))}
# Runs only when data_processed/decomp/input_metrics.csv exists (assembled by
# DECOMP_10_ssp_metrics.Rmd: QED_50 x2 tail policies -> GR4J+GR6J -> projection
# indicators). The chunk stays dormant otherwise so the notebook always knits.
input_fp <- file.path(decomp_output_dir, "input_metrics.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(input_fp))
input_dt <- data.table::fread(input_fp, colClasses = list(character =
                  c("catchment", "arid_tercile", "gcm", "structure",
                    "tail_policy", "metric", "ssp", "window")))

# --- balance guard: an ANOVA on an unbalanced grid is meaningless ----------
# (DECOMP_10 checks this too; here it is enforced at the point of use, and
#  every excluded cell is written to h4_dropped_cells.csv, never dropped
#  silently -- AGENTS.md guardrail 7.)
shape <- input_dt[, .(n = .N,
                      n_gcm = data.table::uniqueN(gcm),
                      n_struct = data.table::uniqueN(structure),
                      n_policy = data.table::uniqueN(tail_policy)),
                  by = .(catchment, metric, ssp, window)]
shape[, balanced := n == n_gcm * n_struct * n_policy]
cat(sprintf("H4 cells: %d | balanced: %d | unbalanced: %d\n",
            nrow(shape), sum(shape$balanced), sum(!shape$balanced)))

cells_all <- shape[, .(catchment, metric, ssp, window)]
unbalanced <- shape[balanced == FALSE, .(catchment, metric, ssp, window,
                                         n, n_gcm, n_struct, n_policy)]

input_dt <- merge(input_dt,
                  shape[balanced == TRUE, .(catchment, metric, ssp, window)],
                  by = c("catchment", "metric", "ssp", "window"))

# --- saturation check (spec v2 section 5.0): the partition must be exact ----
# n_params = 1 + (g-1) [gcm] + 1 [structure] + 1 [tail] + (g-1) [g:s]
#          + (g-1) [g:t] + 1 [s:t] + (g-1) [g:s:t] = g * 2 * 2 = n_obs
# => residual df = 0. Verify on the real input BEFORE any fit (spec mandate).
sat <- shape[balanced == TRUE, .(n_obs = n[1], n_gcm = n_gcm[1]), by = ssp]
sat[, n_params := 1 + (n_gcm - 1) + 1 + 1 + (n_gcm - 1) + (n_gcm - 1) +
       1 + (n_gcm - 1)]
sat[, residual_df := n_obs - n_params]
print(sat)
stopifnot(all(sat$residual_df == 0L))
cat("SATURATED per-cell design confirmed on the real input: residual df = 0\n",
    "in every SSP. The per-cell ANOVA is an exact variance partition:\n",
    "no F, no p, no per-cell eta-partial (=1 identically) or omega-squared\n",
    "(undefined). Inference = pre-registered 5% disjunction + catchment\n",
    "bootstrap; the SS share IS classical eta-squared in this design.\n")

d <- decomp_run(input_dt, metrics = unique(input_dt$metric),
                n_boot = decomp_n_boot, seed = decomp_seed)$shares
data.table::fwrite(d, file.path(decomp_output_dir, "variance_shares.csv"))

# --- no silent drops: which cells produced no decomposition, and why -------
cells_done <- unique(d[, .(catchment, metric, ssp, window)])
zero_var <- data.table::fsetdiff(shape[balanced == TRUE,
                                       .(catchment, metric, ssp, window)],
                                 cells_done)
drop_rows <- list()
if (nrow(unbalanced)) {
   ub <- unbalanced
   ub[, `:=`(reason_code = "unbalanced_factorial", detail = paste0(
      "n=", n, " expected ", n_gcm * n_struct * n_policy))]
   drop_rows[["unbalanced"]] <- ub
}
if (nrow(zero_var)) {
   zv <- zero_var[, reason_code := "zero_variance_or_insufficient_levels"]
   drop_rows[["zero_var"]] <- zv
}
dropped <- if (length(drop_rows)) {
   data.table::rbindlist(drop_rows, fill = TRUE)
} else {
   data.table::data.table(catchment = character(0), metric = character(0),
                          ssp = character(0), window = character(0),
                          reason_code = character(0))
}
if (nrow(dropped))
   data.table::fwrite(dropped, file.path(decomp_output_dir,
                                         "h4_dropped_cells.csv"))
cat(sprintf("ANOVA cells: %d requested | %d decomposed | %d dropped\n",
            nrow(cells_all), nrow(cells_done), nrow(dropped)))

set.seed(decomp_seed)
cats <- unique(d$catchment)
boot_rows <- list()
for (b in seq_len(decomp_n_boot)) {
   pick <- sample(cats, size = length(cats), replace = TRUE)
   boot_rows[[b]] <- d[catchment %in% pick,
      .(share_gcm = stats::median(share_gcm),
        share_structure = stats::median(share_structure),
        share_tail = stats::median(share_tail)),
      by = .(arid_tercile, metric, ssp, window)]
}
boot_all <- data.table::rbindlist(boot_rows, use.names = TRUE)
ci <- boot_all[, .(lo = stats::quantile(share_structure, 0.025),
                   hi = stats::quantile(share_structure, 0.975)),
               by = .(arid_tercile, metric, ssp, window)]

med <- d[, .(median_share_gcm = round(stats::median(share_gcm), 3),
             median_share_structure = round(stats::median(share_structure), 3),
             median_share_tail = round(stats::median(share_tail), 3),
             median_share_gcm_struct = round(stats::median(share_gcm_struct), 3),
             median_share_gcm_tail = round(stats::median(share_gcm_tail), 3),
             median_share_struct_tail = round(stats::median(share_struct_tail), 3),
             median_share_three_way = round(stats::median(share_three_way), 3)),
         by = .(arid_tercile, metric, ssp, window)]
tab <- merge(med, ci, by = c("arid_tercile", "metric", "ssp", "window"))
data.table::fwrite(tab, file.path(decomp_output_dir, "h4_summary.csv"))

# count the decision-rule evidence, per the pre-registered disjunction
n_cells_ge5 <- sum(tab$median_share_structure >= decomp_h4_structure_min)
cat(sprintf("summary cells with structure share >= %.0f%%: %d of %d\n",
            100 * decomp_h4_structure_min, n_cells_ge5, nrow(tab)))

h4_stands <- any(tab$median_share_structure >= decomp_h4_structure_min)
verdict <- if (h4_stands) {
   "H4 STANDS (structure share non-negligible somewhere)"
} else {
   "H4 FAILS (structure < 5% everywhere -- useful negative result)"
}

# GCM coverage actually used (13 vs 14) -- stated in the verdict, never smoothed
cov_fp <- file.path(decomp_output_dir, "h4_gcm_coverage.csv")
cov_txt <- if (file.exists(cov_fp)) {
   cov <- data.table::fread(cov_fp, colClasses = list(character = "ssp"))
   paste0("- ", cov$ssp, ": ", cov$n_gcm, " GCMs")
} else "- coverage file missing (see DECOMP_10)"
cov_txt <- c(cov_txt,
   "- HadGEM3-GC31-MM ssp245/ssp370 are unpublished on ESGF",
   "  (`data_processed/logs/ssp_unavailable.csv`, `gcm_scenario_not_published`).",
   "  ssp245/ssp370 therefore use a 13-GCM balanced factorial (52 runs per",
   "  catchment), ssp126/ssp585 a 14-GCM one (56 runs). Neither is padded.")

writeLines(c(
   "# H4 verdict -- variance decomposition of low-flow projections",
   "",
   paste0("**Date:** ", format(Sys.time()), " | seed ", decomp_seed,
          " | bootstrap resamples: ", decomp_n_boot),
   paste0("**Input:** `data_processed/decomp/input_metrics.csv` | metric_version ",
          paste(unique(input_dt$metric_version), collapse = ", ")),
   paste0("**Cells:** ", nrow(cells_all), " requested, ", nrow(cells_done),
          " decomposed, ", nrow(dropped), " dropped (`h4_dropped_cells.csv`)"),
   "",
   "**Design note (spec v2, 23 Nov 2026).** The per-cell factorial is",
   "saturated (56 or 52 observations = the full parameter count, residual",
   "df = 0): the per-cell analysis is an exact variance partition, not a",
   "significance test. No F, no p, no per-cell eta-partial or omega-squared.",
   "The SS share over the seven terms IS classical eta-squared in this",
   "balanced design. Inference = the pre-registered rule below plus the",
   "catchment bootstrap.",
   "",
   paste0("**Rule (AGENTS.md, pre-registered 18 Nov 2026):** GCM dominates; ",
          "structure share >= 5% in >= 1 tercile x metric means structure ",
          "matters for adaptation. Disjunction over ", nrow(tab),
          " summary cells (3 terciles x 5 metrics x 4 SSPs x 3 windows); the ",
          "rule triggers on the tercile MEDIAN share, not a single catchment. ",
          "Multiplicity of the disjunction is a stated limitation."),
   "",
   paste0("**Verdict: ", verdict, "** (", n_cells_ge5, " of ", nrow(tab),
          " summary cells have structure share >= ",
          100 * decomp_h4_structure_min, "%)"),
   "",
   "## GCM coverage (explicit, not balanced away)",
   "",
   cov_txt,
   "",
   "## Shares by aridity tercile x metric x SSP x window (medians;",
   "lo/hi = 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the catchment bootstrap on the structure",
   "share)",
   "",
   knitr::kable(tab),
   "",
   "Responses never blended: one decomposition per metric per tercile.",
   "All seven ANOVA terms are reported, including the 3-way interaction."),
   file.path(decomp_output_dir, "h4_verdict.md"))
print(tab)
```

## 5. Sensitivity: GCM as a random intercept (spec v2 § 5.6 — supplement only)

```{r lmer-sensitivity, eval=file.exists(file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "decomp", "input_metrics.csv"))}
# The ONLY model in the H4 chain with an error term: residual df ~ 47-51 per
# cell, so this is the only place residual diagnostics / classical effect
# sizes are meaningful. Reports the random-effects GCM share next to the
# fixed-effects share; agreement within ~5 pp = robustness confirmation.
sens_fp <- file.path(decomp_output_dir, "h4_lmer_sensitivity.csv")
if (!decomp_lmer_sensitivity || !requireNamespace("lme4", quietly = TRUE)) {
   cat("lmer sensitivity skipped (flag off or lme4 unavailable); ",
       "the fixed-effects partition remains the primary result.\n")
} else {
   keys <- unique(input_dt[, .(catchment, metric, ssp, window)])
   fixed_lookup <- d[, .(catchment, metric, ssp, window, share_gcm_fixed = share_gcm)]
   sens <- vector("list", nrow(keys))
   n_fail <- 0L
   t_s <- Sys.time()
   for (i in seq_len(nrow(keys))) {
      k <- keys[i]
      cd <- input_dt[catchment == k$catchment & metric == k$metric &
                        ssp == k$ssp & window == k$window]
      m <- tryCatch(
         suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
            lme4::lmer(value ~ structure * tail_policy + (1 | gcm), data = cd))),
         error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(m)) {
         n_fail <- n_fail + 1L; next
      }
      vc    <- lme4::VarCorr(m)
      v_g   <- unname(attr(vc[[1]], "stddev"))^2
      v_res <- unname(attr(vc, "sc"))^2
      sens[[i]] <- data.table::data.table(
         catchment = k$catchment, metric = k$metric, ssp = k$ssp,
         window = k$window,
         share_gcm_lmer = if (is.finite(v_g + v_res) && (v_g + v_res) > 0)
                             v_g / (v_g + v_res) else NA_real_)
      if (i %% 1000L == 0L)
         cat(sprintf("lmer %d/%d | %.1f min\n", i, nrow(keys),
                     as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_s, units = "mins"))))
   }
   sens_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(sens, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
   sens_dt <- merge(sens_dt, fixed_lookup, by = c("catchment", "metric", "ssp", "window"))
   sens_dt[, delta_gcm_share := share_gcm_lmer - share_gcm_fixed]
   data.table::fwrite(sens_dt, sens_fp)
   cat(sprintf("lmer sensitivity: %d cells fit, %d failed (logged)\n",
               nrow(sens_dt), n_fail))
   d_med <- sens_dt[, .(median_delta_pp = round(100 * stats::median(delta_gcm_share,
                                                            na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                        p95_abs_delta_pp = round(100 * stats::quantile(
                           abs(delta_gcm_share), 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), 1))]
   print(d_med)
   agree <- d_med$p95_abs_delta_pp <= 5   # spec: within ~5 percentage points
   verdict_line <- if (agree) {
      "Robustness CONFIRMED: the random-intercept GCM share agrees with the fixed-effects share (95% of cells within 5 pp)."
   } else {
      "Robustness NOT confirmed at the 5-pp level: both shares are reported in the supplement and the divergence is discussed in the limitations. The two estimators answer different questions -- the ICC-style share conditions on the random intercept only (GCM + residual variance), while the fixed share partitions ALL variance including the structure and tail effects -- so a large gap here means the structure/tail effects themselves are large, not that the partition is wrong."
   }
   lines_append <- c("", "---", "",
                "## Sensitivity: GCM as random intercept (supplement)",
                "", paste0("Model: `value ~ structure * tail_policy + (1 | gcm)` ",
                           "per cell (the only H4 model with an error term)."),
                paste0("Cells fit: ", nrow(sens_dt), " | failed: ", n_fail),
                paste0("Median signed difference (lmer - fixed GCM share): ",
                       d_med$median_delta_pp, " pp | 95th |difference|: ",
                       d_med$p95_abs_delta_pp, " pp"),
                paste0("**", verdict_line, "**"),
                "The fixed-effects partition remains the primary result; the ",
                "random-intercept version is a robustness check, never a ",
                "replacement.")
   verdict_fp <- file.path(decomp_output_dir, "h4_verdict.md")
   write(lines_append, file = verdict_fp, append = TRUE)
   cat("verdict file extended with the sensitivity statement\n")
}
```

## Take-away

- The machinery is validated by the planted-effect smoke test (GCM-dominant
  grid recovers gcm > structure > tail ordering; the seven-term partition
  sums to 1).
- The per-cell factorial is **saturated** (spec v2, 23 Nov 2026): the analysis
  is an exact variance partition — no per-cell F, p, eta-partial or
  omega-squared; the SS share IS classical eta-squared here. Verified on the
  real input before any fit.
- All seven terms are reported, including the 3-way interaction: the
  interactions are the evidence that the three uncertainty sources are not
  additive.
- The inference is the pre-registered 5% disjunction rule plus the
  catchment bootstrap; the `lmer` random-intercept model is the one H4 model
  with an error term and is reported as a labelled sensitivity, never as the
  primary result.
- If the structure share is < 5% everywhere, that is the reported result:
  Objective 4 collapses to GCM + bias-correction only (per AGENTS.md).
